task.description:
Implement PRM-02, PRM-03, PRM-04, PRM-05 (Stage 16 MUST, VALIDATED) per design artefacts.

BRANCH: feature/WF02-prm-batch2-20260814 (base: origin/main 05be8706)
DESIGN ARTEFACTS:
- src/design/prm-02-conflict-preflight-rejection.md
- src/design/prm-03-plan-digest.md
- src/design/prm-04-promotion-review-state-machine.md
- templates/specs/prm04-promotion-reviews.migration.yaml (migration_number: 96)
- src/design/prm-05-non-skippable-approval-gate.md

EXISTING CODE TO EXTEND:
- src/definition/promotion.zig (existing promotion pipeline)
- src/definition/rollback.zig (state machine patterns)
- src/promotion/routes.zig (existing promotion API routes)
- src/auth/identity.zig (TENANT_CONTEXT extraction)

MIGRATION:
- Run: python tools/codegen_migration.py templates/specs/prm04-promotion-reviews.migration.yaml
- Apply: zig build migrate
- Verify: zig build migrate exits 0

IMPLEMENTATION TASKS:

PRM-02: Conflict pre-flight rejection
- Add rejectIfConflicts() function — runs BEFORE any transaction opens
- SELECT MAX(version) from target tenant's active definitions for each process_key in the plan
- Conflict: target_version > base_version → return HTTP 409 PROMOTION_CONFLICT
- Append DEFINITION_PROMOTION_REJECTED event in independent transaction
- Move promotion to FAILED state

PRM-03: Plan digest binds approval to a diff
- Implement computePlanDigest() — SHA-256 lowercase hex over canonical JSON (lexicographic key sort, no insignificant whitespace, null included)
- Canonical entry shape: {type, id, change_kind, before, after}
- verifyDigest() with constant-time comparison
- Store digest + serialised plan on promotion_reviews row at submit time
- Validate digest on Approve and Apply requests → HTTP 409 PlanDigestMismatch

PRM-04: Promotion review state machine
- Create promotion_reviews table (migration 096)
- CHECK constraint over 6 statuses: pending_review, approved, rejected, applied, failed, superseded
- 7 permitted edges: pending_review→approved/rejected/superseded, approved→applied/failed/superseded, applied/failed/rejected→superseded
- Partial unique index (tenant_id, plan_digest) WHERE status IN (pending_review, approved)
- row_version for optimistic locking
- superseded_by tracking

PRM-05: Non-skippable approval gate
- No bypass: apply request body has only { plan_digest }, any extra field → HTTP 422
- Self-approval: requested_by == approved_by → HTTP 403
- GET /api/v1/promotions/{id}/context returns: stored plan, artifact assertions, NEEDS_REVIEW package, plan_digest
- GET /api/v1/promotions/{id}/review returns promotion_reviews row

Return PASS when:
- All new/modified Zig source compiles (zig build)
- Migration applies cleanly (zig build migrate)
- zig build test exits 0 (existing tests still pass)
- Git status shows all changes on feature branch
